text:
Maria R.: Heads up — planning a chart bump for payment-service to v2.1.0. This includes a lightweight DB migration. Thinking we do a tenant-scoped pin for prod-1 namespace and run the migration as a canary before cluster-wide rollout.
Aj Patel: Can you paste the migration plan and the exact helm command? Also which release window are we targeting?
Maria R.: Release window: tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Migration plan quick notes:
- Pin chart v2.1.0 only in namespace prod-1 (tenant-scoped)
- Run migration Job with single replica against prod-1 DB
- Smoke tests + 30m observation, if OK promote to other namespaces
- If migration fails, rollback chart to v2.0.5 and revert DB with backup restore plan

Snippets:
```bash
# pin chart in prod-1 (values override)
helm upgrade payment-service redwood/payment-service --namespace prod-1 --install --version 2.1.0 -f values-prod1-pin.yaml

# migration job (one-off)
kubectl apply -f migration-job-prod1.yaml -n prod-1
```

Leah SRE: Do we have a fast rollback path for both chart and migration? Need exact commands and runbook steps in release notes.
Maria R.: Rollback chart command: `helm rollback payment-service <REVISION>` (we'll record the revision before). DB rollback: we have nightly logical backup + one-off pg_dump we can restore; ops runbook section prepared.
Sam P: For release notes: include a short user-facing blurb about payment retry latency fixes + internal migration note. Also add migration checklist for CS and infra. I'll assemble the notes if you give bulleted impacts.
Maria R.: Impact bullets:
- No user-facing schema changes; migration compacts indexes and takes ~5-10m on prod-1 snapshot
- Expected traffic blip <1% while migrating (connection pool pressure)
- Rollout is tenant-scoped initially, so most users unaffected.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot triggered: preflight checks for payment-service v2.1.0 in prod-1. Status: waiting on manual approval.
Aj Patel: @Leah SRE can you pre-approve the emergency rollback playbook? want a quick thumbs if good.
Leah SRE: Reviewing now. Will give :thumbsup: if PG backup restore steps are verified.

Maria R.: Added canary observability hooks:
- log alert if error-rate > 0.5% over 5m
- latency p95 > 600ms alert
- cost/rate limits monitor in console route

ci-bot: ci-bot: pipeline passed for chart lint + helm tests for v2.1.0 (commit a1b2c3).
Sam P: I'll draft release notes and call out the manual approval gate in Console. Also adding a short rollback blurb: how to revert pin and rollback chart.
Maria R.: Final decision: pin v2.1.0 only in prod-1, run migration job at start of window, observe 30m, then proceed to staged rollout across prod-2/3. If any alert fires, immediate rollback per playbook. I'll post the runbook + exact revision numbers here before the window.
Leah SRE: Sounds good. Please include the restore contact (oncall db-sre). I'm on standby during the window.
Aj Patel: Approved from platform side. I'll monitor resource quotas and node pressure.
Maria R.: Thanks everyone. Manual approval will be given 15m before window in this thread so deploy-bot can proceed. :thumbsup:
